requirements.req_text: Do the following: (a) Explain to your counselor the hazards you are most likely to encounter while welding, and what you should do to anticipate, help prevent, mitigate, or lessen these hazards. (b) Show that you know first aid for, and the prevention of, injuries or illnesses that could occur while welding, including electrical shock, eye injuries, burns, fume inhalation, dizziness, skin irritation, and exposure to hazardous chemicals, including filler metals and welding gases.

pamphlet_excerpts: Continue Inspecting Fire: Continue inspecting for fire for 30 minutesafter welding.
Superficial Burns Mildburns: Superficial burns are mildburns that affect only the outer layer of skin.
Treat Them Byholding: Treat them byholding the burn under cold water or applying cool, wet compresses until the pain eases.
Partial-thickness Burns: Partial-thickness burns are moreserious than superficial burns and affect the outer layer of skinand part of the layer of skin below it.
step_by_step_procedure: They Typically Include: They typically include areddening and blistering of the skin.
Firstremove Person Source: To treat such burns, firstremove the person from the source of the burn.
Cool Burnedarea Cold: Cool the burnedarea with cold, running water until the pain is relieved.
Burn Dry Then: Let the burn dry, then protect it with a loosely applied, sterile gauzepad and bandage.

pamphlet_excerpts: Cables Power Source: One of the two cables from the power source is attached tothe work.
Thearc Strikes Electrode: When thearc strikes between the electrode and the workpiece, welding begins.
Heat Arc Measured: The heat of the arc, measured above 9,000 degrees Fahrenheit, melts the tip of the electrode and the surface of the work, near thearc.
Amount Electric Current: The amount of electric current needed at the arc dependson the size of the electrode and the gap between the electrodetip and the base metal.
step_by_step_procedure: Sizes Types Electrodes: The sizes and types of electrodes forshielded metal arc welding define the arc voltage and amperagerequirements.
Current Alternating Direct: The current may be either alternating or direct (electrode positive or electrode negative), depending on theelectrode being used.
Manufacturers Add Alloying: Manufacturers add alloying elements tothe electrode covering to strengthen a shielded metal arc weld.
Welder Shielded Metal: Welder using shielded metal arc welding Common Welding and Cutting Processes Here are some of the more common welding and cuttingprocesses used.

requirements.lead_text: After successfully completing requirements 1 through 5, use the equipment you prepared for the welding process in 5(b) to do the following:
requirements.req_text: After successfully completing requirements 1 through 5, use the equipment you prepared for the welding process in 5(b) to do the following: (a) Using a metal scribe or soapstone, sketch your initial onto a metal plate, and weld a bead on the plate following the pattern of your initial. (b) Cover a small plate (approximately 3" x 3" x 1/4") with weld beads side by side. (c) Tack two plates together in a square groove butt joint. (d) Weld the two plates together from 6(c) on both sides. (e) Tack two plates together in a T joint, have your counselor inspect it, then weld a T joint with fillet weld on both sides. (f) Tack two plates together in a lap joint, have your counselor inspect it, then weld a lap joint with fillet weld on both sides.

pamphlet_excerpts: Manufacturing Businesses: Manufacturing businesses are experiencing a shortage of skilledwelders.
Baby Boomers Born: As baby boomers (those born between 1946 and 1964) continue to retire, skilled welders are needed to replace them.
Despite Lure Salaries: Despite the lure of $40,000 to $70,000 salaries after collegegraduation and on-the-job training, it has been difficult to recruitnewcomers.
Dreary Image Pastcentury: This may be because the dreary image of the pastcentury’s industrial age lingers.
step_by_step_procedure: Thanksto Advances Science: Thanksto advances in science and technology, welding has a new spark.
Skilled Talented Weldershave: Skilled and talented weldershave a brand new place in ourcontemporary world.
Numerouswelding Careers: Numerouswelding careers offer flexible andappealing lifestyles.
Skilled Welderscan Advance: Skilled welderscan advance to robotic weldingtechnicians, inspectors, supervisors, salespersons, professors, and businessowners.
